8.4.30 Eth_ReadMmd
[SWS_Eth_91025] Definition of API function Eth_ReadMmd ⌈
Service Name
Eth_ReadMmd
Syntax
Std_ReturnType Eth_ReadMmd (
uint8 CtrlIdx,
uint8 TrcvIdx,
uint8 Mmd,
uint16 RegIdx,
uint16* RegValPtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x28
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant for different CtrlIdx, non reentrant for same CtrlIdx
CtrlIdx
Index of the controller within the context of the Ethernet Driver
TrcvIdx
Index of the transceiver on the MII
Mmd
MDIO Manageable Device
Parameters (in)
RegIdx
Index of the transceiver register on the MII
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
RegValPtr
Filled with the register content of the indexed register
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Service accepted
E_NOT_OK: Service denied
Description
Reads a transceiver register using Clause45 access if supported by hardware or implements a
Clause45 access using Clause 22 operations
Available via
Eth.h
⌋
[SWS_Eth_00397] Read Mmd
Status: DRAFT
⌈The function shall read the specified transceiver register through the MII of the indexed
controller.⌋
[SWS_Eth_00398] Read Mmd
Status: DRAFT
⌈The function shall be pre compile time configurable On/Off by the configuration pa-
rameter: EthCtrlEnableMmd.⌋
